faceAttention.summary: Enables greeting/following with a chosen idle routine, taking ownership of gaze, mood and autoblink.
prerequisites: Import Person Pose and its declared dependencies.
inputs: 1. eyes greet and follow face: Boolean; library example true.
2. idle: menu.faceIdle; library example sleep and look around.

examples.title: Use eyes greet and follow face … idle …
examples.code: eyes greet and follow face [true] idle [sleep and look around]
examples.explanation: Block notation: Enables greeting/following with a chosen idle routine, taking ownership of gaze, mood and autoblink. Command; disabling releases that behavior.

notes: Local MediaPipe face and optional YOLO arm-pose companion required; inference runs on the computer using the P4 camera. Explicit SIMULATED demo source is also available. Face coordinates 0..1000, top left 0/0; face lease 2 seconds, arm pose 1 second. Greet mode wakes happy, holds through 3 seconds of missing detections, then resumes the selected idle routine. It owns gaze/mood/autoblink until disabled. Eye/head direction is approximate and uncalibrated; brief blinks need a faster camera transport. Stop All disables capture/following. Importing starts no camera.
Source: boards\waveshare_esp32p4_wifi6\integration\Person_Pose.ubl. Examples are illustrative block notation, not hardware acceptance tests.
